title: First, Next, Last
shareTitle: First, Next, Last — Put the Story in Order
description: Choose a watercolor picture story, put its three moments in order, then hear the finished story told aloud. A warm sequencing game for ages 2–6.
learningGoals: Practice narrative sequencing with first, next, and last
Connect cause and effect across a short picture story
Build oral-storytelling vocabulary through spoken narration
interactionModel: tap-tap or drag picture cards into the first, next, and last story spaces
feedbackModel: correct placements settle with a painted check and spoken sequence word; mismatches wiggle, speak a warm nudge, and return for another try; completed stories play back aloud

modes.title: Sunflower Surprise
modes.skill: order a growth and care story
